_declared_values.figures_by_section: Authored 2026-08-27 from 03_script/script.en.v001.md and EP82_valdez_FACTS_LEDGER.v001.md. Counts are 17/17/17/17 across ACT_1..ACT_4, at the top of episode_spec's figure_beats_per_act [13,17]; HOOK 2 and ENDING 2; 72 cards in total. EVERY number on a card is a number the narration speaks -- 900, 1263000, 50, 4, 2, 257, 258000, 25, 3.4, 3, 24, 8, 12, 90, 2.1, 900, 303, 32000, 287, 22.6, 5000, 5, 2.5, 507.5, 11 all appear in the script, and every stat/numberticker `value` is numeric so nothing can render as NaN. No `stat` carries a `group` key. Every range in the record (the one- to two-hour nap, the five-or-six hours, the six recommendations split four and two) is drawn as a kinetic pair or a compbars comparison, never squeezed into a single stat.
_declared_values.no_OP_section: episode_spec's section_vocabulary lists OP, but narration_index has no OP chunks -- the brand opening is an overlay on the HOOK, not a spoken section. A card there would have no window to live in.
_declared_values.quarantine: Nothing on screen states a probable cause for the grounding. MAR-90/04 is a 257-page scan with no text layer and has not been read on this machine; the ACT_1 card that names it says only that it exists and could not be read. No card says the master was drunk, was steering, or caused the grounding -- the vessel was under the third mate's navigational control (VZ-003). No card says the third mate was negligent or asleep: the VZ-109 quote is the Board's own 'could have overcome him', and the card next to it says COULD HAVE / NOT DID. No card says fatigue caused anything. No card says Exxon was uniquely bad -- VZ-201's practice is recorded as widely practised and the six recommendations went to every company in Prince William Sound. No card says the master was removed from employment; VZ-308 is a recommendation and is not drawn. No card touches oiled wildlife, the wreck or the grounding itself, per forbidden_subjects. The ACT_4 cards report the Court's ratio rule and the money already spent, and stop -- no card says the Court let the company off.
_declared_values.act_4_money_scale: The $5,000 against the master and the $5 billion against the company are two separate stat cards, not one compbars pair: at that ratio the smaller bar is one four-hundred-thousandth of the larger and would render as a blank row. The comparison is made by the cut order and the narration, not by a bar chart that cannot draw it.
